_source: Resolved 2026-07-26 from CoA extracted\patch-M\DBFilesClient\SkillLine.dbc (CategoryID==7) cross-referenced with the design pages in TrinityBots\AscensionArchive\archive\coa_classes\*.txt.
_method: Name match first, then ADJACENCY: every CoA class owns three CONTIGUOUS skill-line ids. That is what disambiguates the theme-named lines - e.g. Houndmaster 59 sits between Boltslinger 58 and Inquisition 60, so it is Witch Hunter's 'Darkness' spec ('shadowy hounds tracking evil'), NOT Bloodmage's 'Packleader'.
_rejected: Pure name matching produced false positives that would have poured another class's kit into a CoA branch: 'Blood'->11770 is the Death Knight tree, 'Discipline'->11613 is Priest, and a fuzzy match sent Stormbringer's 'Thunder' to 50 Hunter (1330 spells = the stock hunter tree). All rejected by constraining to ids 40-125.
_note_fourth_specs: Several design pages list a FOURTH spec (Black Knight, Dreadnought, Warden, Valkyrie, Vizier, Mountain King, Packleader) even though the page text says 'one of three specializations'. No skill line exists for any of them in the extract, and every class has exactly three lines. Treated as later additions or page drift; unmapped and NOT imported. Revisit if content turns up.
_poolSize: spells linked to that line in SkillLineAbility.dbc, INCLUDING rank spells - the curated count per spec is far smaller.

5._why: 79 Infinite = Displacement (Infinite dragonflight / time-rewind healer); 81 Time = Duality (Order+Chaos dual magic). Adjacency 79-80-81 confirms the trio.

6._why: 73 Sanguine = Blood (San'layn, health-as-resource); 74 Accursed = Ferocity ('give into the curse'); 75 Eternal = Fleshweaver (healer). Archive slug is son-of-arugal. 'Packleader' has no line.

9._why: 90 Heretic = Influence (dark healer, Yogg-Saron shields). 'Dreadnought' has no line.

10._why: id 95 does not exist in the extract, so 'Valkyrie' is unmapped.

14._why: 59 Houndmaster = Darkness ('shadowy hounds tracking evil'), proven by adjacency to 58 and 60. 'Black Knight' has no line.

15._why: 70 Zealot = Martial (flurry striker); 71 Oathkeeper = Discipline (monk tank, stacking mitigation).

17._why: 114 Grovekeeper = Life; the design page literally writes it as 'Life (Grovekeeper)'. 'Mountain King' has no line.

20._why: LOWEST CONFIDENCE of the set. 119 Riftblade is certain. Spellslinger ('inscribe and unleash Thaumaturgy') -> 117 Engravement, Conjuration ('Runic Familiar' pet) -> 116 Glyphic, by elimination rather than strong theme. Verify by inspecting the actual spells in each line before importing; swapping them is a one-line change.
